### Added

- (agent-platform) [Change Harness on the agent page, and earlier-revision sessions marked](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3160) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — `Change Harness…` in an agent's actions menu moves it to another runtime after showing whether it can run there. On the agent's Sessions tab, sessions started before the change are marked `Earlier revision`. Needs agent-manager 2.7.0 or later.
- (agent-platform, gs-backend) [Plugins on the agent wizard's skills step](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3168) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Where the skill repositories hold plugins, the new agent wizard's step becomes `Select skills and plugins`: a Claude Code plugin is picked whole, an Agent Plugins package skill by skill. Edit keeps an agent's plugins. Needs agent-manager 2.6 or later.

### Development and CI/CD

- (deps) [Refresh vulnerable transitive dependencies](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3167) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- (e2e) [Scope the connector address error to its field](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3170) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The agentlab form-validation spec checks the connector address error on its own field, so it no longer fails because the screen-reader announcement repeats the same text.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.12.0...v3.13.0
